scoped_qualifications.summary: Optional layer_observations on single-member proof layers (len(members) == 1) should remain omitted in reviewed acceptance policies unless _layer_aggregation is also applied to 1-member layer_observations.
scoped_qualifications.details: In _proof_chain (acceptance.py:570-591), _layer_aggregation(sample, layer, members, aggregate, policy, parsed, raw) is called when len(members) > 1 (lines 577-579), while lines 589-590 append aggregate to candidates whenever aggregate is not None. In all catalog and test fixtures, layer_observations is attached only on multi-member layers (len(members) > 1, such as Fenrir leaf batches 2/4/6), and single-member layers bind directly to member['receipt_roles'][phase]. When reviewing future post-deployment acceptance policies/samples, keep layer_observations restricted to multi-member layers (or optionally invoke _layer_aggregation whenever aggregate is not None).
